name: kazi-legal-za
description: Grounds your firm's own Claude in your live Kazi data over MCP: drafts monthly fee notes from unbilled time, runs section 86 trust-reconciliation checks, reviews FICA/KYC gaps, briefs matter status, triages new-matter intake, and closes the correspondence loop — files an email into the right matter and digests what needs a reply. Tuned for South African legal practice. The read-and-draft skills are reviewed and committed in Kazi by hand; the correspondence skills file directly (audited) and only propose follow-up tasks the attorney approves in Kazi. Trust stays read-only.
